summary: Five qualified executed multifamily rent comps in Charlotte within 8 miles with event dates in the 2025-09-01 to 2026-08-31 window were selected and ranked by distance ascending. Effective net rents (client undiscounted convention: annualized face rent, 2.5% step-ups at months 13/25/37/49, no face rent during free months, monthly gross expense deduction across every month of term, TI subtracted once, divided by term and annualized) range from $9.47 to $22.12 psf/yr: R1298 $11.28 (0.80 mi), R9957 $16.93 (1.03 mi), R2302 $19.41 (1.26 mi), R6740 $9.47 (1.49 mi), R6049 $22.12 (1.72 mi). Controlling updates applied: U-R9957-1 (executed amendment, effective 2026-08-20: free_months 4, TI $18). Excluded updates: U-R2302-2 (executed but effective 2026-09-10, after cutoff) and U-R6740-3 (unsigned draft). R1927 duplicates entity ALDER-REN-19075 and was deduplicated in favor of R1298 (single slot). Two further eligible comps (R2543 1.95 mi $23.69; R6844 2.18 mi $12.77) fell outside the five-slot limit. A comp-grid XLSX with live formulas and citations was produced (artifacts/underwriting-v1.xlsx).

Executed lease 1.26 mi away, 60-month term, NNN (zero expense deduction), 2 free months, TI $18. Base face rent $22.60/sf/yr retained because U-R2302-2 (rent $2) is published/effective 2026-09-10, after the 2026-08-31 cutoff, and therefore does not control.

Executed lease 1.49 mi away. $2.01/sf/mo = $24.12/sf/yr. Gross with known $6.25/sf/yr expenses charged in all 36 months, 3 free months, TI $21. Unsigned draft U-R6740-3 (free_months 8) does not override the executed base extract.
Executed lease 1.72 mi away, 48-month term, NNN (zero deduction), 0 free months, TI $12, face $24.20/sf/yr with 2.5% annual step-ups. Fifth and final slot by distance ranking.

limitations: Effective rents follow the client's undiscounted rent-only convention (no time value, no discounting, no vacancy/credit loss) and are not a market appraisal or value indication.
Escalations are applied as full annual steps at months 13/25/37/49 on the annualized face rent; partial-year or mid-term escalation timing in the actual documents is not evidenced.
Free rent is assumed to occur in the first months of term and to abate face rent only; gross expense deductions are charged in every month including free-rent months, per the stated convention.
NNN comps have annual_expenses_psf null; the convention sets the NNN deduction to zero, so net rents for NNN and gross comps are not fully like-for-like.
U-R2302-2 would reduce R2302's face rent to $2 but is effective 2026-09-10 (after cutoff) and was excluded; if it were effective, R2302's ranking metric would change materially.
U-R6740-3 (free_months 8) is an unsigned draft and was excluded; the executed base terms may later be amended.
R1927 and R1298 report identical terms for entity ALDER-REN-19075; only one slot was used, but which document is the primary abstract is not evidenced beyond evidence_kind labels.
Distances, areas and expense loads are taken as supplied; no independent verification of geography, unit mix or lease clauses was possible.
Two otherwise-qualifying comps (R2543, R6844) were omitted solely because of the five-comp cap, so the shortlist is distance-weighted rather than a full market sample.
